blocking_inconsistencies.description: No budget response is present in docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ (directory contains only a .gitkeep placeholder; no budget response file). Absent budget artifacts in the integration received/ directory constitute a blocking gate failure, not a hold state, per CLAUDE.md §8.4 and §13.4. Because no response was received, interface-contract conformance and structural WP/partner coverage against wp_structure.json could not be evaluated.
blocking_inconsistencies.resolution_note: A budget response must be received in docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ and validated for interface-contract conformance and structural consistency with wp_structure.json before the budget gate can pass on the lump-sum path. Until a conforming, structurally consistent response is present, gate_pass_declaration remains fail and Phase 8 is hard-blocked.
